strings.balloon_pop_desc: Lass die Zahl platzen, die zur 10 fehlt!

notes.l4_msg_good: "Good effort" is the middle-score message, not full praise: "Gut versucht" as in chunk 04 (l1_quiz_good), "Gut gemacht" says well done
notes.balloon_pop_desc: "die zur 10 passt" is vague; the school phrase for the complement is "die zur 10 fehlt" (Was fehlt zur 10?), same length
notes.merge2048_desc: "Zahlen vereinen" is not said in German (vereinen = unite people/countries); "zusammenfügen" is the natural merge verb
notes.trophy_speed_200_desc: "in irgendeinem Spiel" reads careless ("in whatever game"); "in einem Spiel" = in any one game, shorter for the one-line trophy card
